name: Maiker Uplands (now Verrbena)
award: 2024 Federal 4% and state housing tax credits (Round Two)
headline: Maiker Housing Partners (the Adams County Housing Authority) is building Maiker Uplands, since renamed Verrbena, a four-story, 70-unit, all income-restricted building for households at 30% to 70% AMI, including units for adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities and a ground-floor Adams County Head Start space, at 2880 W. 88th Avenue in Westminster's Uplands master plan. It won 2024 Round Two federal 4% and accelerated state credits from CHFA, with $17.52M of bonds issued by the housing authority itself.
why_it_matters: A housing authority issuing its own bonds and pairing a 4% deal with neuro-inclusive (Kelsey standard) units and a Head Start preschool inside a market-rate master plan, where affordable units gate the release of market-rate homes; reported construction start in 2026 and equity closing in May 2026.

status.label: Under construction per architect and trade press; completion expected July 2027
status.detail: A Colorado Real Estate Journal article reposted by the architect on 2026-06-17 says Maiker closed $16.68M of equity in May (2026 inferred) and construction started in March, with completion expected in July 2027; the architect's project page lists it as under construction. No building permit or bond closing record was found in city or issuer documents.

next_step: Watch for Westminster certificate of occupancy and lease-up notices for Verrbena around mid-2027, and the Head Start tenant improvement permit.

background.text: Maiker first applied in 2024 Round One with a paired structure: a 38-unit 9% condominium ('Orion', including 10 I/DD units) and a 32-unit 4% bond condominium ('Vega') in one 70-unit building serving 30% to 60% AMI, plus the Head Start space. After that round it reapplied as a single 70-unit 4% deal at 30% to 70% AMI (inferred that the Round One bid was not awarded).
Westminster's Planning Commission approved the official development plan 7-0 on 2024-07-09, with a City Council hearing scheduled for 2024-09-09, per the application.

The application warned that delay past a 2025 start could cost the Adams County NSP money, city support tied to the city's Proposition 123 commitment, alignment with the public sewer main, and the Head Start anchor tenant.

The market study (JRES Intelica, 2024-07-22) found capture rates of 2.4% at 30% AMI, 3.6% at 40%, 12.8% at 50% and 10.5% at 70% AMI, and 14.4% overall. The Phase I (Terracon, 2023-09-18) found no recognized environmental conditions.
Neighborhood meetings drew few opponents; most concerns were about off-site improvements, per the applicant.
Maiker announced the tax credit award on 2024-12-18. Westminster listed Maiker at Uplands (70 units) among 317 affordable units under development review or in progress as of August 2025.

discrepancies.text: The 2024 Round Two application has 18 units for residents with intellectual and developmental disabilities, while the City of Westminster and Maiker's December 2024 announcement say 10 such units.
The application gives a 2.173-acre parcel, while the architect gives 2.03 acres.
The application describes a roughly 7,389 sq ft Head Start space plus a 4,000 sq ft playground, while the trade press describes an 11,000 sq ft Head Start daycare and playground.
The architect's project page lists completion in 2026, while the trade press reports expected completion in July 2027.
The application names JHL Constructors as general contractor, while the trade press names Deneuve Construction Services.
